title: GOV-0007: Issue and PR bodies have no enforced shape
problem:
## Observed
`check_pr_traceability.py` checks two lines. The Observed / Expected / Evidence / Unknowns / Proposed-WP structure that #19, #22, #24, #25, #26 follow is a convention typed by hand; nothing on GitHub asks for it, and PR bodies are free text. `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` and `.github/pull_request_template.md` are absent on `c510516`.

## Expected
> Issue = demand / problem contract — never a solution contract. Draft PR = live delivery dossier.
A form that asks for the problem contract's fields, and a PR template that asks for the traceability lines and the verification-on-committed-SHA block, so the shape is requested at the point of writing rather than reconstructed at review.

## Evidence
`ls .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE .github/pull_request_template.md` → no such file, on `c510516`.

## Unknowns
Issue Forms bind the web UI only — `gh issue create --body-file` bypasses them. Whether CI should also validate the Issue body's shape (that needs the network; the gate makes no calls, but a separate CI step can).

## Proposed work package
Patch tier, promised as a "separate Issue" in #19's scope boundary: `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/demand.yml`, `pull_request_template.md`, and `check_pr_traceability.py` extended to the template's required headings.
